payload.title: Wiki pages need something to say before they are published
payload.description: Found while investigating the 2026-11-02 Machines on Machines junk (PPY-5b5a5d, PPY-84b0dd). Even with the vocabulary filter (v5.72.0), a page is made for every accepted entity of a vocabulary kind, and one with no reviewed description gets a stub line ("X is listed here as a product.") plus empty knowledge blocks. The first wiki publish of a site with many AI-accepted generated entities can still be a long list of stubs. Decide a rule from the site's own data, not a fixed cap: for example publish a page only when the entity has a reviewed description, or when its mentions (distinct published items) are more than the site's learned typical for entities of that kind; keep everything else as private drafts. Needs Ryan's decision on what a page must have. Not covered by the preview gate, which only makes a person look. Gherkin specs.
